answer: Because the grove derivation is checked against the mirror nonce, the delta audit keeps the accepted values and a reused text fails on the first character. That binds the text to one identity's challenge, so copying between 37 aliases produces 37 mismatches and pays the authoring cost with no payout. An answer must include the first 16 hex characters of the seed it was derived under, and a wrong or missing derivation is rejected at intake. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
